{{Otheruses|Western Reaches}}
The '''Western Reaches''' were a remote area on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] containing the [[Earl of Vis' castle|castle]] of the [[Earl of Vis/Legends|Earl of Vis]]. After abdicating as [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|king]], [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]] went into hiding in the Western Reaches to try to avoid retaliation from [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]], whom he had tried and failed to assassinate.
